title: Unambiguous arbitrary high-dimensional Bell states analyzer via indefinite causal order
summary: High-dimensional quantum systems greatly outperform their two-dimensional counterparts in channel capacity, quantum complexity and efficiency, quantum communication security, etc. Bell-state analyzer (BSA) is a crucial prerequisite for a number of quantum communication protocols. We propose an approach for completely and deterministically distinguishing a set of arbitrary $d$-dimensional ($d \geq 3$) Bell states via indefinite causal order (ICO).
